description: Reading the blockr options that core's scheduler reads, which core asks R for as soon as R has answered its hello. The app sets evaluation_queue as the R option blockr.evaluation_queue, which arrives as the number it holds, and the deployment sets BLOCKR_BACKGROUND_EVALUATION_DELAY, which arrives as the string an environment variable holds, for the client to convert to its fallback's type. Nothing sets gate_visibility, which R leaves out, so that the client takes its fallback.
